title: LIGHT SEATED INTERVALS
subtitle: THURSDAY EASE. SHORT BURSTS. ALL SEATED.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Thursday is light seated intervals — short, gentle bursts from the chair, nothing fierce. About ten minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Stay seated if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Light intervals done, and you showed up. Enjoy your day — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair. Lift one knee gently, then lower with control. Alternate sides like a soft march. Soft ankle, soft hip — only a comfortable height. Smaller lift is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts. Two sets of eight per leg. Sit tall, lift one knee softly, lower with control. Alternate like a gentle march. Keep it easy.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Stay seated. Soften the hips.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD PRESS
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Light weights or empty hands at shoulder height. Press gently overhead only as far as feels kind, then lower with control. Soft ribs, soft neck. Smaller range is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead press. Two sets of eight. Sit tall, press softly overhead only as far as feels kind, then lower with control. Easy on the shoulders.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Stay seated. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Light weights or empty hands. Draw elbows back as if rowing, squeeze the shoulder blades gently, then release. Soft on the neck. Stay seated the whole way. Smaller range is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row. Two sets of eight. Sit tall, draw the elbows back softly, squeeze the shoulder blades, then release. Easy on the neck.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Stay seated. Soften the shoulders.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall on the chair. Hinge gently from the hips with a long spine. Reach toward your shins — stop well short of pain. Breathe into the back of the legs. Smaller range is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach. Two holds of twenty seconds. Sit tall, hinge softly from the hips, long spine. Only as far as feels kind.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Sit upright and breathe.
exercises.speakDone: Forward reach done. That's the session — lovely work.
